cards.scene: an elegant woman in a sheer flowing gown that clings to breast and hip, a falcon on her gloved hand, her other hand touching ripe grapes, nine coins along the arbor beam, a snail at her feet
cards.hair: long vine-dark hair, loosely waved, bound back with a ribbon

cards.emblem: ten pentacles in a tree-of-life pyramid
cards.title: TEN OF PENTACLES

count.layout: exactly ten coins on the wall in a Tree-of-Life pyramid — 4 on the bottom row, 3 above them, 2 above those, 1 at the apex, 4 + 3 + 2 + 1 = 10; all ten discs countable, none hidden behind the figures

cards.scene: a family hall — a patriarch seated, a couple standing with his hand at her waist, a child playing with two dogs — ten coins in a pyramid emblem on the wall behind them
cards.hair: warm brown hair in a thick braid coiled at the nape

cards.emblem: a pentacle held by two hands
cards.title: PAGE OF PENTACLES

count.layout: exactly one large coin, held in both hands; no other coin anywhere

cards.scene: a studious young woman page in an open robe studying one large pentacle coin held in both hands, a plowed field behind her
cards.hair: dark blonde hair falling loose and straight to the shoulders

cards.emblem: a pentacle on a draft horse
cards.title: KNIGHT OF PENTACLES

count.layout: exactly one coin, resting in his open palm; no other coin

cards.scene: a patient bare-chested knight on a heavy black draft horse standing still, examining one pentacle coin in his palm, a plowed field behind

cards.title: QUEEN OF PENTACLES

count.layout: exactly one coin, resting in her lap; no other coin

cards.scene: a warm nude queen with a flower crown on a goat-carved throne, one breast bared, one pentacle resting in her lap, a rabbit in the garden
cards.hair: deep brown hair with a ruddy sheen, thickly curled and falling to her waist

cards.emblem: a pentacle above a bull head
cards.title: KING OF PENTACLES

count.layout: exactly one coin, held in one hand; no other coin

cards.scene: a robust bare-chested king with a beard and an ermine cloak on a bull-carved throne, one pentacle and a scepter in hand, harvest fields behind
